{{Quote|Battles and invasions have been reported in more than a dozen systems. Imperial fleets are being forced to intervene in the Vexta Belt, Entralla, Dactruria, and Tovarskl.|A newscaster during the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
The '''Vexta system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Carrion sector/Legends|Carrion sector]] through which ran the shipping lanes of the [[Delephran]] corporation. The company's transports were attacked in the Vexta Belt by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] until Delephran mobilized its militia to wipe out the attackers.
